citation: Austin-Zimmerman I, et al. Genome-wide association studies and cross-population meta-analyses investigating short and long sleep duration. Nature Communications. 2023;14:6059.

source_reported_result.sleep_cohorts: UK Biobank and Million Veteran Program
source_reported_result.disorder_summary_source: Psychiatric Genomics Consortium summary statistics; exact release/accession used for this correlation is not crosswalked in the article text

brain6_comparison.sleep_case_definition: self-reported sleep duration >=9 hours versus 7-8 hours
brain6_comparison.disorder_source: Trubetskoy 2022 PGC3 Wave 3 European autosomal stratum
brain6_comparison.overlap_status: UK Biobank contributes to the published long-sleep GWAS; participant overlap with Brain6 long-sleep discovery is therefore possible. Exact PGC release/cohort overlap is unresolved.
brain6_comparison.interpretation: Directionally and numerically similar published estimate; not an independent replication or a Brain6 reanalysis. Do not combine estimates or calculate heterogeneity because their covariance is unknown.
